rdfs:label: hasSubOrganization
rdfs:comment: A sub-organization of this Organization — a subsidiary, department or other organization it contains or controls; may itself be a FormalOrganization. For internal units without legal status, use the narrower hasUnit.
notes: Inverse of `urn:solid:subOrganizationOf`. Use to enumerate subsidiaries, departments or other sub-organizations belonging to a parent. Repeat for multiple children. When the child is an internal OrganizationalUnit, `urn:solid:hasUnit` is the narrower form.

examples.title: Company with engineering and sales units

history.note: Comment/notes no longer restrict values to OrganizationalUnits (that is hasUnit); added hasUnit to notToBeConfusedWith.
